compiled_state.description:
## Observation
`rebar-autodeploy-errors` changed state 6 times between 18:11 and 18:46 PDT on 2026-10-23 (01:11 to 01:46 UTC 2026-10-24): ALARM at 18:11, 18:26 and 18:41, OK at 18:16, 18:31 and 18:46 (CloudWatch `describe-alarm-history`). The alarm is `Sum` of `rebar/host:deploy_errors`, period 900s, 2 of 4 datapoints, `notBreaching`.

The raw metric (60s resolution, 17:04 to 18:59 PDT) holds exactly 2 non-zero datapoints, each Sum 1: 17:55 PDT and 18:00 PDT (00:55Z and 01:00Z). Every other datapoint is 0.

Host journal, `rebar-autodeploy.service` (read-only SSM, instance i-00880b2c7f13527c5, host clock UTC): `AUTODEPLOY_ERROR` reason `config_manual` at 00:53:31Z and 00:55:31Z, both naming target `10fd0737eb7`, plus an `AUTODEPLOY_DEFERRED` reason `review-in-flight` at 00:53:31Z for the same target.

Commit `10fd0737eb7` ("Condense reconciler and compose comments") edits `infra/compose/gerrit.config`, which is in `CONFIG_PATHS` in `infra/scripts/autodeploy.sh`. The non-comment, non-blank lines of that file are identical before and after the commit (checked by diffing the comment-stripped content of `10fd0737eb7~1` and `10fd0737eb7`). The commit message also says the configuration payload is preserved.

## Root cause
`autodeploy.sh` runs `changed "$CONFIG_PATHS"`, which is `git diff --name-only` between the deployed and target SHAs, and emits `AUTODEPLOY_ERROR config_manual` on any path difference. A comment-only or whitespace-only edit to a watched config file therefore reports a manual operator apply that does not exist. While a deploy is deferred (here `review-in-flight`), each timer tick re-runs the check and emits another error, which produced the 2 datapoints 5 minutes apart.

The repeated state changes are a separate effect of those 2 datapoints. CloudWatch re-aligns 15-minute buckets on each evaluation, so the 2 errors sit in adjacent buckets (2 of 4 breaching, ALARM) at some evaluations and in one bucket (1 of 4, OK) at others. ALARM fell on the :11/:26/:41 evaluations and OK on :16/:31/:46, which matches that alignment.

Not established: whether the alarm's repeated state changes are intended behaviour for two close errors. The fix below addresses only the false error, not the alarm shape.

## Approach
1. In `infra/scripts/autodeploy.sh`, replace the bare path-difference test for `CONFIG_PATHS` with a helper that signals only when a changed config path differs in content after removing whole-line comments (first non-space character `#`, but not `#!`) and blank lines and trailing whitespace. Compare `git show <deployed>:<path>` with `git show <target>:<path>`.
2. Fail toward signalling: a path added, removed, unreadable at either revision, or differing in any other line still emits `config_manual`. Comment syntaxes other than whole-line `#` (for example `;` in git-config files) are treated as content, so they still signal.
3. Change nothing else in the autodeploy flow and do not change the alarm definition.

## Scope
In scope: `infra/scripts/autodeploy.sh` and `tests/scripts/test_autodeploy_signals_gerrit_config.py`. Out of scope: the other detect-only classes (`nginx_edge_manual`, `nginx_materializer_manual`), the alarm period and datapoint settings, and the deferral logic.

## Testing
Extend the existing shell-stub test `tests/scripts/test_autodeploy_signals_gerrit_config.py`. Its git stub must answer `git show <sha>:<path>` with per-revision content so the new comparison has data. Cases:
- a real content change to `infra/compose/gerrit.config` still emits `config_manual` (existing parametrized cases keep passing);
- a comment-only change emits no `AUTODEPLOY_ERROR`;
- a whitespace-only change emits no `AUTODEPLOY_ERROR`;
- a change that mixes a comment edit with a content edit emits `config_manual`;
- a path missing at one revision emits `config_manual`.
```
pytest tests/scripts/test_autodeploy_signals_gerrit_config.py -q
make verify
```
Failure case: before the change the comment-only test fails, because the script emits `config_manual` for it.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] `pytest tests/scripts/test_autodeploy_signals_gerrit_config.py -q` passes, including a comment-only case that emits no `AUTODEPLOY_ERROR` (checked: the test fails on main and passes after the change).
- [x] A content change and a mixed comment-plus-content change to a watched config path still emit `config_manual` (checked: parametrized tests).
- [x] `make verify` is green on the Linux CI gate (`Verified +1` on the Gerrit change).

## Follow-up
Observing a live comment-only config commit stay quiet after deploy depends on a future commit, so it is tracked in its own ticket (linked discovered_from) rather than held open here.
